hearthborn.name: Hearthborn
hearthborn.blurb: Raised where the fire never dies, you carry two more Toughness and your bench eases the sorest ally by one.

ashwalker.name: Ashwalker
ashwalker.blurb: Out of the burned places you always carry something, a fresh relic at the start of every quest.

fenwise.name: Fenwise
fenwise.blurb: Marsh raised and quick to read the reeds, your WITS die surges on its top face and the face beneath it.

ironbound.name: Ironbound
ironbound.blurb: Rust rings your wrists, so you carry one more Armor and every floor on your gear reads one higher.

straycall.name: Straycall
straycall.blurb: Called in from the cold with no name, you roll MIGHT and GRACE one rung higher and NERVE one rung lower.

lanternborn.name: Lanternborn
lanternborn.blurb: Born under a lantern that never gutters, you see hidden numbers, and once a stage you look ahead.

saltblood.name: Saltblood
saltblood.blurb: Brine in your veins keeps you standing, and your first Push each stage costs you no Strain.

unmarked.name: Unmarked
unmarked.blurb: No mark, no clan, no grave dug for you yet, so a fifth die rolls at creation and replaces your lowest stat.

vanguard.name: Vanguard
vanguard.blurb: You go down the rope first, so your MIGHT floor is half its die, four at best, and Strikes land one less.

cutpurse.name: Cutpurse
cutpurse.blurb: Quick fingers in the dark, your first GRACE check each stage rolls twice and keeps the higher.

scholar.name: Scholar
scholar.blurb: You read the failures like tide marks, so after an ally fails this stage you add two to your next check.

zealot.name: Zealot
zealot.blurb: The hurt is your hymn, and while you carry two or more Strain every check you make adds two.

warden.name: Warden
warden.blurb: You keep the watch while the others sleep in the wet, and your bench clears three Strain instead of one.

gambler.name: Gambler
gambler.blurb: Bone dice in a horn cup, once a stage you redraw one check, yours or an ally's, and the new result stands.

herald.name: Herald
herald.blurb: You carry the cry down the line, and you add one when your stat matches the ally who rolled before you.

reaver.name: Reaver
reaver.blurb: Salt and iron in the swing, so a MIGHT check that passes and surges deals two more to an Aspect.

hollowAir.name: Hollow Air
hollowAir.blurb: The air down here has no breath left in it, and no die surges.

rustbound.name: Rustbound
rustbound.blurb: Rust eats every buckle and plate, so your Armor counts as nothing.

shivering.name: Shivering
shivering.blurb: The cold climbs into your hands, and every floor is ignored.

pressgang.name: Pressgang
pressgang.blurb: Every hand is taken for the oar, so nobody benches and the third of you takes one Strain each stage.

thinIce.name: Thin Ice
thinIce.blurb: The floor is ice over black water, and the first failure each stage costs two Strain.

blindfold.name: Blindfold
blindfold.blurb: A rag bound over the eyes, so no TN shows and only the shape tells you what waits.

gate.name: Gate
gate.blurb: A gate of rusted iron across the way, one check on one named stat.

chain.name: Chain
chain.blurb: A chain hauled hand over hand, one of you takes two checks on one stat, three then four, and both must pass.

relay.name: Relay
relay.blurb: A lantern passed across black water, two of you take one check each, and both must pass.

vault.name: Vault
vault.blurb: A sealed door under the silt, you pick the stat, the TN is seven, and a rich relic waits behind it.

toll.name: Toll
toll.blurb: A ferryman's hand held out in the dark, you pay one Strain to try, and the TN is three.

open.name: Open
open.blurb: An open stretch of dry stone, any stat you like against a TN of three, a safe place for the hurt.

depths.name: Verge
depths.blurb: The lip of the world where the salt drip starts, six stages with the boss at the last of them.

depths.name: Hollows
depths.blurb: Caves the sea gutted long ago, eight stages with a boss at the fourth and the last of them.

depths.name: Undertow
depths.blurb: The current pulls under here and never lets go, so Strain stays between stages and only the bench clears it.

depths.name: The Silt
depths.blurb: Drowned things sleep in the silt, every boss grows a fourth Aspect and sealed Vaults must open to go on.

depths.name: Marrowdeep
depths.blurb: The bone of the world, where no one comes down to replace the fallen and nothing common is left in the dark.

how: MIGHT, GRACE, WITS and NERVE are dice, and the larger die rolls higher.
Every stage lays two cards on the wet stone, and you choose who faces what.
Push puts your shoulder to it, one Strain before the roll, two on the total.
The one you keep back is the bench, and the bench clears Strain.
The boss shows its Aspects, and every round each one still standing strikes.
The dead stay dead, and every grave pays in Marrow and a Legacy.

cards.retire: {name} hangs up the lantern and climbs out.
cards.wipe: The deep keeps them, and the choir of the sunk learns their names.
cards.salvage: What the dead carried comes back up as {renown} Renown.
cards.scar: {name} takes a Scar, and Toughness drops by one.
cards.title: Bone and salt under the world, and the dice you send down into it.
